'''Jedi Mind Trick''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] that performed in [[Tathin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], at the award ceremony for the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'' [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]].
